name: Demon Fall Canyon
summary: Demon Fall Canyon is a scarred, fel-corrupted gorge situated in southern Ashenvale. It marks the legendary battleground where Grommash Hellscream and Thrall confronted the pit lord Mannoroth, ending the demonic blood curse that had enslaved the orcish race for a generation.

sections.title: The Fall of Mannoroth
sections.body: Carved into the rugged southern borders of Ashenvale near Felfire Hill and Demon Fall Ridge, this canyon bears the heavy scars of the Third War. It was here that Warchief Thrall and chieftain Grommash Hellscream tracked down the pit lord Mannoroth to break his hold over the Horde. During the fierce duel, Mannoroth incapacitated Thrall, but Grom seized the opening to drive his axe, Gorehowl, straight into the demon's chest. The resulting infernal explosion shattered the pit lord and slew Grom as well, permanently liberating the orcs from their lingering demonic servitude.

sections.title: A Sacred Yet Dangerous Chasm
sections.body: Following Mannoroth's demise, the Horde dubbed the canyon to commemorate Grom's final stand, erecting a monument nearby to honor his redemption. Despite the pit lord's destruction, his violent death unleashed raw demonic power that thoroughly tainted the surrounding land. Today, the canyon remains saturated in fel magic and crawls with hostile lingering lesser demons, making any pilgrimage to this hallowed ground a perilous venture.

faq.q: Why is this place called Demon Fall Canyon?
aliases: how did it get its name
faq.answer: The canyon was named by the Horde to commemorate the death of the pit lord Mannoroth, who fell here after being slain by Grommash Hellscream.

faq.q: What happened between Grom and Mannoroth here?
faq.answer: Thrall and Grom confronted Mannoroth together. Thrall was knocked unconscious, but Grom dealt a lethal blow with his axe. The violent explosion of demonic fire released by Mannoroth's demise fatally wounded Grom, freeing his people from the blood curse with his dying breath.

faq.q: Why are there still demons roaming the canyon?
faq.answer: When the pit lord Mannoroth died, the tremendous blast of demonic energy permanently corrupted the canyon floor, leaving behind lingering fel corruption that attracts and harbors lesser demons.
A memorial monument honoring Grom Hellscream stands nearby in the vicinity of Demon Fall Canyon, where Horde pilgrims come to pay tribute to the warrior who freed their people.

angles.text: This scorched ground is sacred to the Horde as the site of Grommash Hellscream's ultimate sacrifice, where the blood curse of the Burning Legion was finally broken.
Every orc owes their spiritual and physical freedom to the battle fought in this canyon, where Grom traded his life to shatter their demonic bondage.
